comment: ANCHOR: JOURNAL_TABS_20261104 — FQ-041: at phone width the journal tab row WRAPS (flex-wrap: wrap, overflow-x: visible) instead of scrolling the last tab off the edge; the base rule keeps its horizontal scroller for wide viewports, and all 15 tab labels remain rendered (nothing removed).
